A *connector* connects Pointsman to another system: it brings cases in and carries the results out. [Connectors](../connectors.md) explains the idea.

## `@pointsman/github`

Connector `github` of the module `@pointsman/github`. Setup and details: [its page](../github-connector.md).

| What | Values |
| --- | --- |
| Runs | in its own Worker |
| Actions | `check`, `comment`, `label`, `request_reviewer`, `approve`, `dismiss`, `decision_comment` |
| Settings | `GITHUB_APP_ID`, `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`, `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `GITHUB_CONNECTOR`, `POINTSMAN_URL`, `POINTSMAN_TOKEN`, `POINTSMAN`, `PULL_REQUESTS` |

## `@pointsman/fiware`

Connector `fiware` of the module `@pointsman/fiware`. Setup and details: [its page](../../bridge/README.md).

| What | Values |
| --- | --- |
| Runs | inside the Pointsman Worker, or in its own Worker |
| Actions | `write-result`, `create-decision-entity`, `create-task`, `cancel-task`, `resolve-review`, `send-feedback` |
| Settings | `BRIDGE_ROUTES`, `BRIDGE_WORK_ORDERS`, `POINTSMAN_URL`, `BROKER_URL`, `BROKER_TENANT`, `BROKER_CONTEXT`, `NOTIFY_SECRET`, `POINTSMAN_TOKEN`, `BROKER_TOKEN`, `BROKER_API_KEY`, `BRIDGE_QUEUE`, `BRIDGE_DEAD_LETTER` |
